summary: Completed testing of Boracay integration and new provider flow. All 8 features working correctly: (1) laboutique@sportlyo.fr sees 'Boutique Personnalisee' title with Import TopTex/XD Connects/Boracay tabs, (2) boutique2@sportlyo.fr sees 'Boutique Personnalisee' but NO import tabs + 'Demander un import de catalogue personnalise' section, (3) is-main-partner API returns correct values, (4) external products endpoint correctly excludes main partner, (5) custom import request sends message with [DEMANDE IMPORT CATALOGUE] prefix, (6) Boracay categories endpoint returns 13 categories, (7) organizer Prestations Externes has working view toggle between 'Mes prestataires' and 'Produits & services partenaires', (8) secondary partner can add products manually via 'Nouveau produit' button.
seed_data_creation: Created test products for boutique2 and laboutique during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main partner email is laboutique@sportlyo.fr - only this user sees Import tabs (TopTex, XD Connects, Boracay). Other providers (boutique2@sportlyo.fr, boutique@sportlyo.fr/Moreati) see manual entry form + 'Demander un import de catalogue personnalise'. External products endpoint at /api/provider-products/external correctly filters out main partner's products. Organizer Prestations Externes section has toggle between 'Mes prestataires' and 'Produits & services partenaires'.

feature_1_main_partner_dashboard.details: laboutique@sportlyo.fr sees 'Boutique Personnalisee' title with Import TopTex, Import XD Connects, Import Boracay tabs. Boracay section shows 13 category buttons.

feature_2_secondary_partner_dashboard.details: boutique2@sportlyo.fr sees 'Boutique Personnalisee' title but NO import tabs (only Catalogue, Selections, Finances, Ventes, Commandes, Messages). Shows 'Demander un import de catalogue personnalise' section with input and send button.

feature_3_is_main_partner_api.details: GET /api/provider/is-main-partner returns is_main_partner: true for laboutique@sportlyo.fr, false for boutique2@sportlyo.fr and boutique@sportlyo.fr (Moreati)

feature_4_external_products_api.details: GET /api/provider-products/external returns 15 products from non-main providers (Moreati, EquipSport Lyon). Correctly excludes main partner's products. Requires organizer/admin role.

feature_5_custom_import_request.details: POST /api/provider/request-custom-import sends message to admin with [DEMANDE IMPORT CATALOGUE] prefix. Empty message rejected with 400.

feature_6_boracay_categories.details: GET /api/provider/import/boracay/categories returns 13 categories (Porte-cles, Metallerie, Gourde & Drink, Accessoires, Lanyard & Lacet, High-Tech, Outdoor & Sport, Bagagerie, Green / Eco, Coffrets Cadeaux, Packaging, Express, Nouveautes). Boracay lookup endpoint validates URLs correctly.

feature_7_organizer_prestations_externes.details: Organizer dashboard shows 'Prestations Externes' section with toggle between 'Mes prestataires' (shows 2 prestataires) and 'Produits & services partenaires' (shows 15 external products). Products display provider name, price, contact info.

feature_8_manual_product_creation.details: boutique2@sportlyo.fr can click 'Nouveau produit' button and add products manually via the product dialog form.

mocked_apis.Boracay scraping: Hits real boracay.fr website for product data
